_note: Campaign zones (Z1, Tim 2026-11-19, docs/frontier_campaign_plan.md). Not the town zoning in frontier.json 'zones'. A zone is a group of world.json regions; a region listed with xMin/xMax belongs to the zone only inside that x span (xMin included, xMax excluded). townCap = towns one clan may have in one zone. siege.zonesNeeded = zones a clan must hold to attack a castle, one of them the castle's zone or a zone touching it. castle.site = a world.json site id, or castle x, z for a spot that is not a site (East Plains: the cape, Tim 2026-11-19); sea = the side the dock faces; blocksSites = town spots the castle stands on or beside, closed to founding; a castle is not a town. Names are placeholders.
_castleSpacing: Z5 placeholder: nobody founds a town on foot within this many units of a castle spot. Castle x, z (Z5, 2026-11-19): where the default castle fits nearest the picked site, land part on buildable ground and the dock in the sea (to_delete/_zones/fit_near.mjs); with a site id the site is closed too.

emptyTowns._note: Z6d (2026-11-20) placeholders: a fallen clan's towns stand empty. A hero claims one by channelling claimSeconds within reach of its town hall (within the zone cap); a hit starts it over. Unclaimed, its buildings turn to ruins after ruinDays and the town is gone after decayDays (game days).

ship._note: the ship between the city harbour pier and your castle dock (sim/frontier/ferry.js); placeholders

berth._note: Z7 (Tim 2026-11-20): the ship drawn at the city pier and the castle docks, the coastal ship model a size larger until a passenger ship is made (render/ferry_ships.js). city [x, z, direction row 0-7] in city units; castle: out = units off the dock's end into the water, side = units along that end, turn = lying across the dock's line. Set by eye

rivals._note: Z2 (Tim 2026-11-19), placeholders, Tim to tune. Each rival bot clan rolls a home zone (never playerHome) and one hidden strategy, saved with the game (sim/frontier/rival_campaign.js). After the boss's own first town, a rival founds a new town everyDays days after its last one while it has fewer than maxTowns founded towns, can pay, and a site is free under the zone cap: home zone first, then the zones touching it, then onward. Its settlers land at the home harbour and run to the site at trekSpeed (world units a second). noWarWhileLand: the bot general starts no war while the clan may still found. warRyo: no war with less than this in the clan treasury. weakest: the general picks the town with the fewest military buildings among those it knows.
